svg.aria-label: ANDROID · LAUNCHER: An Android Home Screen Where the App Name Is the Icon. A text-only Android launcher, live on Google Play — app names set in type instead of icons, every swipe reassignable, and a widget stack driven by broadcasts rather than polling.
